- **self**: Background-Compaction Skip/EMA Heuristic (14/3)

## How it works

- [statement] In __background_compact_should_skip, a tracked file is skipped when its last attempt did not shrink the file OR its recorded bytes_rewritten is strictly less than conn->background_compact.bytes_rewritten_ema, after earlier eligibility and retry-bypass checks. Equality alone does not trigger the below-average skip. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://github.com/wiredtiger/wiredtiger/blob/develop/src/conn/conn_compact.c · keywords: Background-Compaction Skip/EMA Heuristic
- [statement] An attempt succeeds when start_size minus end_size is positive. Concurrent growth can make an attempt unsuccessful even when it rewrites bytes. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://github.com/wiredtiger/wiredtiger/blob/develop/src/conn/conn_compact.c · keywords: Background-Compaction Skip/EMA Heuristic
- [statement] The architecture guide describes background compaction as using accumulated success statistics to focus on promising tables. The inspected source additionally shows that even a previously successful file can be skipped when its bytes rewritten is below the connection EMA. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://source.wiredtiger.com/develop/arch-compact.html · keywords: Background-Compaction Skip/EMA Heuristic · also: https://github.com/wiredtiger/wiredtiger/blob/develop/src/conn/conn_compact.c

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] The inspected implementation stores the EMA on the connection and the last bytes_rewritten and success outcome in each file’s tracking record; the comparison therefore uses a shared average across files rather than a separate EMA per file. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://github.com/wiredtiger/wiredtiger/blob/develop/src/conn/conn_compact.c · keywords: Background-Compaction Skip/EMA Heuristic
- [statement] The inspected cleanup removes tracking records when the service is disabled, on exit, or when their recorded attempt time exceeds max_file_idle_time. The tracking lookup also discards a URI record when its stored file id differs from the metadata id, preventing reuse of an old file’s history for a replacement with the same URI. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://github.com/wiredtiger/wiredtiger/blob/develop/src/conn/conn_compact.c · keywords: Background-Compaction Skip/EMA Heuristic

## Facts and statements

- [statement] In __wt_background_compact_end, successful shrinkage updates bytes_rewritten_ema to (uint64_t)(0.1 * compact_bytes_rewritten + 0.9 * previous_ema). The quantity averaged is bytes rewritten, not bytes recovered, elapsed time, or a benefit-to-cost ratio. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://github.com/wiredtiger/wiredtiger/blob/develop/src/conn/conn_compact.c · keywords: Background-Compaction Skip/EMA Heuristic · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/third_party/wiredtiger/dist/stat_data.py
- [statement] An otherwise eligible file without a tracking record is attempted. For a tracked file, run_once bypasses the previous-outcome/EMA skip, and elapsed time greater than or equal to max_file_skip_time also bypasses it. prev_compact_time is set at the start of an attempt, so this elapsed-time comparison is measured from that recorded start. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://github.com/wiredtiger/wiredtiger/blob/develop/src/conn/conn_compact.c · keywords: Background-Compaction Skip/EMA Heuristic
- [statement] The architecture guide says background compaction uses historical statistics to favor tables likely to reclaim space and avoid unnecessary attempts; it also skips the initial system-wide checkpoint described for ordinary compaction. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://source.wiredtiger.com/develop/arch-compact.html · keywords: Background-Compaction Skip/EMA Heuristic
- [statement] The architecture guide requires cache dirty content excluding updates to be below eviction_dirty_trigger and overall cache content below eviction_trigger before processing the next table. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://source.wiredtiger.com/develop/arch-compact.html · keywords: Background-Compaction Skip/EMA Heuristic
- [statement] Statistics distinguish background_compact_ema, described as moving average of bytes rewritten, from background_compact_bytes_recovered. background_compact_skipped_unsuccessful counts skips following unsuccessful or below-average compaction. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/third_party/wiredtiger/dist/stat_data.py · keywords: Background-Compaction Skip/EMA Heuristic
- [statement] The cached autoCompact manual describes continuous-mode failed collections as temporarily skipped and retried after approximately one hour. This operator-facing description does not specify the source-level EMA formula or guarantee an exact retry deadline. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/autoCompact.md · keywords: Background-Compaction Skip/EMA Heuristic
- [statement] The EMA update is inside the bytes_recovered > 0 branch. An attempt that leaves the file unchanged or larger sets prev_compact_success=false and does not update the EMA, even if it rewrote bytes. Concurrent operations can grow the file while compaction does work. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://github.com/wiredtiger/wiredtiger/blob/develop/src/conn/conn_compact.c · keywords: Background-Compaction Skip/EMA Heuristic
- [statement] run_once does not bypass every skip: the inspected function checks exclusions, missing files or permission errors, and file_size <= WT_MEGABYTE before the run_once history bypass. Passing this scheduler predicate also does not guarantee actual space reclamation. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://github.com/wiredtiger/wiredtiger/blob/develop/src/conn/conn_compact.c · keywords: Background-Compaction Skip/EMA Heuristic · also: https://source.wiredtiger.com/develop/arch-compact.html
- [statement] The metadata candidate walk consults tracked statistics before opening a data handle to avoid unnecessary attempts. Its skip path increments background_compact_skipped; the previous-outcome/EMA predicate additionally increments background_compact_skipped_unsuccessful, while background_compact_ema exposes the moving average of bytes rewritten. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://github.com/wiredtiger/wiredtiger/blob/develop/src/conn/conn_compact.c · keywords: Background-Compaction Skip/EMA Heuristic · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/third_party/wiredtiger/dist/stat_data.py
